item.title: PlanetScale: Video Editor
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote US

We're looking for a Video Editor who will help shape how videos get made at PlanetScale. You'll work with our team to edit and animate YouTube videos, social shorts, conference highlights, case studies, and launch films, with free rein to use any tool that makes them better, including ones that didn't exist six months ago.

AI is reshaping the video editing space in similar ways to how it is transforming software broadly. We're looking for someone who embraces this new world of creating, combining this with your own personal craft to make excellent video content. We give you the room, the tools, and the time to both create and experiment.

What we're looking for

  • A portfolio that shows strong editing across formats. YouTube, short form edits, podcasts, etc.
  • A sharp sense of pacing, structure, and story: you know what to keep, what to cut, and how to time things to maintain an engaged audience.
  • Equal comfort with editing, animation, and design: you can shape a story, incorporate interesting visuals, and set clean, expressive type that reads well on any screen.
  • Fluency in professional editing tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro.
  • Experience using AI tools to create animations, assist with editing, and the curiosity to push the limits of how these can be used in a video creation workflow.
  • Ability to create custom scripts and leverage AI to automate parts of your pipeline, such as transcription, thumbnail ideation, and generating rough edits of large amounts of footage.
  • Work closely with our team to help shape ideas before the edit starts, and iterate on feedback quickly.

What you'll edit

  • YouTube videos, from explainers to interviews, paced to hold attention start to finish.
  • Shorts and vertical clips for social platforms.
  • Conference talks, full-talks from our events and clips to share on socials.
  • Launch videos, where timing, polish, and pacing carry the announcement.
  • Thumbnails, title cards, typography, and motion graphics that go with all of the above.

How you'll work

  • A combination of strong individual editing skills combined with an excitement for how AI can improve the speed and quality at which we create.
  • In close collaboration with the Marketing team at PlanetScale.
  • You'll have time and budget to try new tools.

Bonus points

  • Background in Software Development, or working with Engineering companies
  • Experience editing tech / developer content
  • A channel or account you've grown yourself
  • Experience with code-driven video tools like Remotion
  • A knack for creating engaging thumbnails and titles
  • Sound design and audio mixing skills
  • Experience shooting or directing your own footage
  • Livestream or live event production experience

Why PlanetScale

PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there’s any way we can make the interview process better for you; we’re happy to accommodate!

Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

An employee’s total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview. 

Base salary range: $150,000 - $200,000

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes. 

PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn’t be higher.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-video-editor

item.title: StockX: Director, Category Growth (General Manager)
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.

Why you’ll love this role:

StockX has redefined the global marketplace for culture — where buyers and sellers transact with confidence on an always-on digital exchange. We are building the next frontier of creator-driven, culturally rich commerce that blends excitement, community, expertise, and transaction in one platform.

To power this next chapter, we are building a category-led organization where each major vertical operates with clear ownership, accountability, and cultural authority.

The Director, Category Growth (General Manager) is the business owner of a major category vertical. This leader is accountable for the full P&L and long-term trajectory of their category — including supply growth, liquidity, demand activation, monetization, and marketplace health.

You will operate as a true GM: setting vision, defining strategy, allocating resources, building a team, and driving cross-functional execution. You will represent your vertical at the leadership level and ensure that product, marketing, operations, and partnerships are aligned to unlock sustainable growth.

This role is both entrepreneurial and executive — suited for a leader who wants to build and scale a culturally driven business within a high-impact marketplace.

What you’ll own:

Full-Stack Category P&L

  • Own revenue, contribution margin, liquidity, and growth targets for your vertical
  • Develop annual and multi-year business plans, forecasts, and investment cases
  • Allocate resources across acquisition, retention, and engagement to maximize ROI
  • Drive pricing, incentives, and promotional strategies aligned to marketplace health

Vertical Strategy & Market Leadership

  • Define the long-term category vision, positioning, and competitive differentiation
  • Identify expansion opportunities across adjacent segments, geographies, and seller tiers
  • Establish scalable supply acquisition and retention strategies
  • Continuously assess competitive dynamics and evolving cultural trends

Supply, Demand & Liquidity Engine

  • Architect the playbook for acquiring, activating, and retaining high-value sellers and creators
  • Ensure balanced marketplace dynamics between supply depth and demand velocity
  • Partner with Growth and Marketing to stimulate demand moments and category engagement
  • Implement structural improvements that increase conversion, retention, and monetization

Cross-Functional Executive Leadership

  • Influence Product roadmap to improve seller tooling, pricing mechanics, discovery, and trust features
  • Partner with Marketing to launch culturally relevant campaigns and high-impact moments
  • Collaborate with Operations to optimize onboarding, seller support, and fulfillment performance
  • Represent your vertical in executive planning, QBRs, and strategic reviews

Team & Organizational Build-Out

  • Hire and develop Category Managers and supporting roles as the vertical scales
  • Establish operating cadence, reporting frameworks, and performance management systems
  • Build repeatable GTM playbooks that can be deployed across additional categories
  • Foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and community authenticity

Ecosystem & Community Stewardship

  • Act as the senior face of StockX within your category’s ecosystem
  • Build relationships with top sellers, shops, creators, and community leaders
  • Ensure platform growth remains culturally credible and aligned with community norms

About you:

  • 10+ years of experience in marketplace leadership, category general management, business development, or growth roles within consumer tech or two-sided platforms
  • Demonstrated ownership of revenue or P&L-level outcomes
  • Proven track record of scaling a vertical, marketplace segment, or new business line
  • Strong executive presence and experience influencing cross-functional roadmaps
  • Deep fluency in marketplace mechanics: liquidity, take rate, CAC/LTV, cohort behavior, supply elasticity
  • Experienced people leader with a track record of building high-performing teams
  • Deep connection to culture-driven or enthusiast categories

Why this role is different: 

This is not a traditional category marketing or merchandising role. This is a vertical GM role with real business ownership.

You will:

  • Build and scale a culturally driven marketplace vertical from early-stage to maturity
  • Directly influence product, pricing, and growth strategy
  • Operate with executive visibility and measurable business accountability
  • Create the blueprint for how category-led growth powers the future of StockX
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.
 
Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $160,000 to $200,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary. 
 
About StockX

StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com.
 
 
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job. However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. StockX reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. StockX may utilize AI to rank job applicant submissions against the position requirements to assist in determining candidate alignment.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stockx-director-category-growth-general-manager

item.title: Coinbase: Broker Dealer Operations, Associate
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As an Associate, Broker Dealer Operations, you'll join the Coinbase Capital Markets team within Finance and help run the daily operational engine behind our U.S. equities brokerage experience. This team keeps customer accounts, trades, cash, positions, transfers, and corporate actions accurate, controlled, and scalable. You'll execute core broker-dealer workflows, investigate exceptions, and drive improvements that make the operation safer and more efficient for millions of customers.

What you'll do:

  • Execute daily trade, position, balance, and cash reconciliations between Coinbase and Apex records, investigating and resolving breaks with full documentation.
  • Support customer account onboarding and maintenance workflows, including documentation review, status follow-up, and exception escalation.
  • Process inbound and outbound securities transfers (ACATs) end-to-end, from intake review and eligibility checks through submission, tracking, and exception resolution.
  • Monitor operational alerts and exception queues, prioritize customer- and risk-impacting issues, and coordinate remediation across Engineering, Product, Trading, CX, Compliance, Finance, and Apex.
  • Support corporate action operations by reviewing event notices, monitoring deadlines, validating allocations, and investigating post-event discrepancies.
  • Identify recurring failure modes and propose practical improvements to reduce manual work, shorten resolution time, and improve customer outcomes.

Required skills and experience:

  • 2+ years in financial services operations, brokerage operations, clearing and settlement, trade support, or a related operational control function.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. equities trade lifecycle concepts, including order processing, settlement, positions, cash movements, corporate actions, and account transfers.
  • Demonstrated experience investigating data breaks or operational exceptions across multiple systems and driving issues to documented resolution.
  • Proven ability to follow documented procedures consistently in a regulated environment while exercising sound judgment on exceptions outside the runbook.
  • Familiarity with clearing platforms (e.g., Apex Clearing), Jira, SQL, or workflow-automation tools used in brokerage operations.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Position ID: P78331

#LI-Remote

$121,410—$127,800 USD

  • Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

item.title: PlanetScale: Solutions Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - EMEA, Remote - NA

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the transactional database market. The PlanetScale platform offers both Postgres and Vitess clusters. Vitess, an open-source database clustering system for horizontal scaling of MySQL, enables businesses to efficiently handle large-scale data workloads — without sacrificing developer experience.

PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for early members of our Sales team that can form deep partnerships with our prospects and customers to help them adopt and succeed on the next generation of database infrastructure.

 

What's the job to be done?

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Engineering throughout the pre-sales and post-sales journey as the technical expert helping customers solve their most challenging database problems.
  • Lead technical discovery to match customers’ business and technical objectives with PlanetScale’s offerings.
  • Design and execute proof of value timelines that deliver on agreed upon business outcomes and success criteria. 
  • Design database migration strategies and work hands-on with customers to execute migrations to PlanetScale's PostgreSQL and Vitess platforms.
  • Assess workloads, analyze performance requirements, and recommend architecture, sizing, and optimization strategies.
  • Build tools, scripts, and automation that accelerate migrations and improve customer onboarding.
  • Create educational content including documentation, guides, blog posts, workshops, and videos.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and shape the platform.

 

These attributes best describe you…

  • You have deep expertise in database systems including replication, high availability, sharding, performance tuning, and migration strategies.
  • You're equally comfortable presenting architecture designs to executives and writing scripts to automate migration tasks.
  • You thrive in customer-facing situations and translate technical concepts into business value for diverse audiences.
  • You're self-motivated and can manage multiple engagements simultaneously with minimal oversight.
  • You enjoy creating content and sharing knowledge through various formats.
  • You're comfortable with occasional travel (less than 20%).

 

What you will need

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL in production, including operations, performance tuning, and troubleshooting OR
  • 5+ years of experience supporting customers with MySQL or PostgreSQL workloads where you advised on operations, performance tuning, and troubleshooting
  • Experience working with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, or OCI)
  • Proven success in customer-facing technical roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
  • Strong understanding of database migration strategies and tooling
  • Experience evaluating database solutions including architecture reviews, capacity planning, and performance analysis
  • Ability to write scripts and tools in Python, Go, or JavaScript
  • Experience creating technical content such as documentation, tutorials, or blog posts

 

What else will help you be successful

  • Experience with AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) or logical replication tools
  • Knowledge of Vitess, database sharding, or distributed database systems
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Contributions to open-source projects or active participation in database communities
  • Public speaking experience at conferences or meetups

 

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Solutions Engineer, you'll guide customers through transformational database migrations and help them unlock the full power of PlanetScale's platform.

PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

 

Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Base salary range: $160,000 - $250,000 USD

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-solutions-engineer
